name: ログイン状態の記憶
prompt:
Redraw the component as a final, compact Japanese checkbox row. This is a localized correction of attempt 1: the inset white checkmark shape is good, but attempt 1 made the checkbox and text far too large and left excessive top and bottom whitespace. Reference 2 is authoritative for the exact 390 × 72 layout, positions, Japanese wording, text size, and green selection color. Reference 1 is authoritative for the source checkmark being inset. Use reference 3 for tick shape only, never for overall scale or canvas proportions.

The full white canvas must have a 390:72 aspect ratio. Center the row vertically at y=36. Place a selected green square at x=24, y=27, exactly 18 × 18 px, with a crisp white tick inset from every edge. Put the exact label 「ログインしたままにする」 at x=52, y=24, in Meiryo Regular 14 px with 24 px line height, zero letter spacing, and dark #1D1D1D. Use #047857 for the square and a subtle 3 px corner radius. The component should occupy the canvas as a compact row, without oversized glyphs or generous top/bottom padding.

Output only the single white 390 × 72 checkbox row. Do not add a card, tint, border, heading, login form, sample email, password, button, logo, or any other content. Preserve the Japanese text exactly.
reviewNotes: Selected attempt 2 after comparing both raw generations and 390px-width inspection. Inset white tick and exact Japanese label are closest to source/native, but raw 2048x768 aspect 2.667 does not match native 390x72 aspect 5.417; at 390px width the row sits around y62 instead of y27 and the label begins around x60 instead of x52. No third generation. Registered needs-correction; no crop/stretch applied to the stored candidate.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
